items.text: Connect mines a show from its first episode: putting an episode in line brings the earlier ones.
An episode Connect won't mine by itself shows a ⛏ Mine button instead of the hourglass.
Junban no longer re-runs when you come back to the window and nothing changed.
Connect cuts a word's card from a line nobody else talks over.
Side by side: no flicker or order change after Connect mines an episode.
Updates: a cancelled one never blocks the next, and a dropped download resumes or says Try again.
